sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="DELETE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book A Metro Ticket">33c57fa647730310b12deee3716d43b2</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:86163be647730310b12deee3716d43a6</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Auto populate Fare - Starting From</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading) {
        return;
    }

    // Replace with the sys_ids from YOUR Metro Station's Details table
    var AMEERPET      = 'afa47f2647730310b12deee3716d439b';
    var MADHAPUR      = '8815f76647730310b12deee3716d43de';
    var LB_NAGAR      = 'f6157b6647730310b12deee3716d438c';
    var KUKATPALLY    = '2925bb6647730310b12deee3716d43af';
    var JUBILEE_HILLS = '7325fb6647730310b12deee3716d43a6';

    // Single journey fare per passenger (return = double)
    var fares = {};
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + MADHAPUR]      = 30;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + LB_NAGAR]      = 50;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + KUKATPALLY]    = 30;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + JUBILEE_HILLS] = 20;

    var source      = g_form.getValue('starting_from');
    var destination = g_form.getValue('going_to');
    var journeyType = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');
    var passengers  = Number(g_form.getValue('no_of_passengers'));

    g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
    g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

    // Same fare in both directions
    var fare = fares[source + '_' + destination] || fares[destination + '_' + source];
    if (!fare || !passengers || !journeyType) {
        return;
    }

    if (journeyType == '1') {
        g_form.setValue('amount_for_single_journey', passengers * fare);
    } else if (journeyType == '2') {

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="DELETE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book A Metro Ticket">33c57fa647730310b12deee3716d43b2</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:efd6bf2a47730310b12deee3716d43c4</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Auto populate Fare - Journey Type</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading) {
        return;
    }

    // Replace with the sys_ids from YOUR Metro Station's Details table
    var AMEERPET      = 'afa47f2647730310b12deee3716d439b';
    var MADHAPUR      = '8815f76647730310b12deee3716d43de';
    var LB_NAGAR      = 'f6157b6647730310b12deee3716d438c';
    var KUKATPALLY    = '2925bb6647730310b12deee3716d43af';
    var JUBILEE_HILLS = '7325fb6647730310b12deee3716d43a6';

    // Single journey fare per passenger (return = double)
    var fares = {};
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + MADHAPUR]      = 30;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + LB_NAGAR]      = 50;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + KUKATPALLY]    = 30;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + JUBILEE_HILLS] = 20;

    var source      = g_form.getValue('starting_from');
    var destination = g_form.getValue('going_to');
    var journeyType = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');
    var passengers  = Number(g_form.getValue('no_of_passengers'));

    g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
    g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

    // Same fare in both directions
    var fare = fares[source + '_' + destination] || fares[destination + '_' + source];
    if (!fare || !passengers || !journeyType) {
        return;
    }

    if (journeyType == '1') {
        g_form.setValue('amount_for_single_journey', passengers * fare);
    } else if (journeyType == '2') {
        g_form.setValue('amount_including_return', passengers * fare * 2);
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-11 12:08:47</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0f7fbfa647b30310b12deee3716d4304</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Auto populate Fare - Journey Type</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_0f7fbfa647b30310b12deee3716d4304</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-11 12:08:47</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="DELETE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book A Metro Ticket">33c57fa647730310b12deee3716d43b2</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:0a96b72a47730310b12deee3716d4397</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Auto populate Fare - Going To</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading) {
        return;
    }

    // Replace with the sys_ids from YOUR Metro Station's Details table
    var AMEERPET      = 'afa47f2647730310b12deee3716d439b';
    var MADHAPUR      = '8815f76647730310b12deee3716d43de';
    var LB_NAGAR      = 'f6157b6647730310b12deee3716d438c';
    var KUKATPALLY    = '2925bb6647730310b12deee3716d43af';
    var JUBILEE_HILLS = '7325fb6647730310b12deee3716d43a6';

    // Single journey fare per passenger (return = double)
    var fares = {};
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + MADHAPUR]      = 30;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + LB_NAGAR]      = 50;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + KUKATPALLY]    = 30;
    fares[AMEERPET + '_' + JUBILEE_HILLS] = 20;

    var source      = g_form.getValue('starting_from');
    var destination = g_form.getValue('going_to');
    var journeyType = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');
    var passengers  = Number(g_form.getValue('no_of_passengers'));

    g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
    g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

    // Same fare in both directions
    var fare = fares[source + '_' + destination] || fares[destination + '_' + source];
    if (!fare || !passengers || !journeyType) {
        return;
    }

    if (journeyType == '1') {
        g_form.setValue('amount_for_single_journey', passengers * fare);
    } else if (journeyType == '2') {
        g_form.setValue('amount_including_return', passengers * fare * 2);
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-11 12:08:29</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>a66fb7a647b30310b12deee3716d43f4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Auto populate Fare - Going To</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_a66fb7a647b30310b12deee3716d43f4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-11 12:08:29</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
